name: tackle-ticket
description: End-to-end ticket workflow: fetch ticket -> plan -> branch -> code + tests -> multi-model review loop (Opus + Sonnet + Haiku + Codex) -> open PR. /tackle-review runs just the review loop on the current diff, with no ticket system. Generic and config-driven; run /tackle-setup once per repo. Bundles a caveman-derived terse mode to cut review output tokens.
